blocks.title: Feedback mechanism
blocks.text: Feedback mechanism woh hai jis mein qaboo karne wala nizam khud us amal ki paidawar se qaboo hota hai jise woh chala raha hai. Endocrine system do qism ke feedback mechanisms, positive aur negative, se qaboo mein rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Endocrine system mein feedback ki do qismein kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Positive feedback, jo amal tez karta hai, aur negative feedback, jo use rokta hai.

items: Feedback: paidawar apne banane wale amal ko qaboo karti hai; positive ya negative.
